violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver, who also serves as a van driver, did not have proof of current first aid.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver, who also serves as a van driver, did not have proof of current first aid.
One caregiver did not have current pediatric first aid training with rescue breathing. The last training expired in February of 2023.
During investigation, it was determined that a caregiver alone with a group of children did not have pediatric first aid training at the time of a playground injury.
Caregiver without First Aid Certification was left alone with children.
Three caregivers did not have CPR/First Aid training certificates.
One teacher did not have current CPR and First Aid training and has been employed since January of 2022.
